observations.claim: The reply says a p-value of 74% means a 74% chance that the gap is pure noise, which misreads what a p-value measures.
observations.learnerCost: The learner carries a false rule into real work: a p-value is not the probability that the result is chance.

location.detail: {{ai}} showed a 74% chance it's pure noise.

observations.claim: The note says a 74% chance of random luck means the trial found no real advantage, which misreads the p-value and draws a false conclusion.

location.detail: Even when one percentage is slightly lower, a 74% chance of random luck means the trial found no real advantage.
